subject: prd/docgate
statement: When fold state, source-map projection, checkpoint materialization, or repair routing tests whether an ID prefix is registered and addressable, docgate shall use membership in its version-pinned addressable table-schema registry—the registry represented by `schema.TableSchemas`—and shall not infer addressability from membership in the lexical ID-token registry represented by `schema.Prefixes`.
rationale: `F` is intentionally recognized as a citation token but has no addressable table schema; treating the two registries as equivalent invents governance and an impossible repair obligation for flow prose
fit_criterion: an exact registry fixture proves every table-schema key is prefix-eligible for addressability outside §0; `F1` still parses as a lexical token but the real workbench-ui and planner-driven-model-routing F1..F5 rows remain absent from fold state and source maps and require no DOD-7 repair proof; a non-§0 G/J/M/R/EVT/Q/ABUSE/EVAL/NG/WR row remains addressable
